meta.name: baoyu-danger-x-to-markdown
meta.description: Converts X (Twitter) tweets and articles to markdown with YAML front matter. Uses reverse-engineered API requiring user consent. Use when user mentions "X to markdown", "tweet to markdown", "save tweet", or provides x.com/twitter.com URLs for conversion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把X推文和文章转成带元数据的Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要保存X平台的内容到本地做笔记或备份。
copy.tagline_en: Convert X tweets and articles to Markdown with YAML front matter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to save X content locally for notes or backup.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把 X（Twitter）的推文、串文和文章转成 Markdown 格式，并附带 YAML 头部信息。
howto.when: 当你提到“X to markdown”、“tweet to markdown”、“save tweet”，或者提供 x.com/twitter.com 链接时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 X 文章保存为 Markdown 文件。
say.note: Claude 会提取文章全文并生成 Markdown。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert X (Twitter) tweets, threads, and articles into Markdown format with YAML front matter.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "X to markdown", "tweet to markdown", "save tweet", or provide x.com/twitter.com URLs.

say_en.text: Convert this tweet to Markdown: https://x.com/user/status/123
say_en.note: Claude will ask for consent first, then convert.

say_en.text: Save this X article as a Markdown file.
say_en.note: Claude will extract the full article and generate Markdown.
